job.job_description:
Role: Data Engineer / Backend Developer

Experience: Fresher / 1-3 Years

Location: Gurugram




Key Skills / Keywords: JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, SQL, Snowflake, AWS, REST API, Data Engineering, Data Pipelines, ETL/ELT, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, IAM, CloudWatch, Backend Development, System Design, Git, Docker.




Short Job Summary: Looking for a Data Engineer / Backend Developer with 02 years of experience to work on backend applications, REST APIs, data pipelines, databases, Snowflake, and AWS cloud services. Freshers with strong programming, SQL, backend, and academic/project experience are welcome.

Ideal Candidate



0-3 years of experience
Strong knowledge of JavaScript, Node.js, and Express.js
Good understanding of SQL and databases
Knowledge of Snowflake
Basic hands-on understanding of AWS
Understanding of REST APIs and backend development
Basic knowledge of system design and data structures
Good analytical and problem-solving skills
Candidates with academic projects in Backend Development, AWS, Data Engineering, or SQL can be considered



Education: B.Tech/B.E./BCA/MCA/B.Sc./M.Sc. in Computer Science, IT, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
job.ai_reason: Strong backend experience with FastAPI, REST APIs, AWS, and system design, but lacks JavaScript/Node.js and Snowflake.
